title: Characterization by the Doubled Pair Encoding
statement: For every pair of binary words $x,u$ and every natural number $q$, the condition that $x$ has the doubled encoding of $u$ starting at position $q$—each bit of $u$ repeated twice, followed by $01$—holds if and only if the suffix of $x$ beginning at $q$ is the concatenation of that doubled encoding and the suffix of $x$ beginning at $q+2|u|+2$.
